dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「正真正銘の重役出勤だなあ、朝倉」
dialogues.en: "......Ew, I was breathing the air you blew out? Gross!"
dialogues.text: "......Ew, I was breathing the air you blew out? Gross!"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.en: "Anyway!"
dialogues.text: "Anyway!"

dialogues.jp:
どこから出てきたのか、冷静に、なおかつ深く
考えてしまう。
dialogues.en:
He sits on the front seat backward with his elbows on the
back of the chair and a big smile on his face.
dialogues.text:
He sits on the front seat backward with his elbows on the
back of the chair and a big smile on his face.

dialogues.jp:
「んあぁ、そういや、お前と同じクラスになっ
　たんだったか」
dialogues.en: "You're taking someone else's seat."
dialogues.text: "You're taking someone else's seat."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「……お前なあ、昨日も同じクラスで同じ空気
　を吸っていただろうが。その中には、俺の吐
　いた息も混じっていたんだぞ」
dialogues.en:
"Don't you worry. I already got permission from the person
who sits here. And the next class is free study time."
dialogues.text:
"Don't you worry. I already got permission from the person
who sits here. And the next class is free study time."

dialogues.jp:
無意味にニカニカと笑いながら、前の椅子に、
背もたれに肘を乗せて座った。
dialogues.en: "Free study time, huh?"
dialogues.text: "Free study time, huh?"

dialogues.jp: 「お前、邪魔。前の人が座れないだろうが」
dialogues.en:
I like study time, but I hope he isn't going to stay here
for the whole time.
dialogues.text:
I like study time, but I hope he isn't going to stay here
for the whole time.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「心配するな。この席の主には許可は取ってあ
　る。しかも、次は自習だ」
dialogues.en: "So we can talk! We can talk about that person."
dialogues.text: "So we can talk! We can talk about that person."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「おお、自習か」

思わず口元がにやけるが、まさかこいつ、ずっ
と前に居座るつもりじゃないだろうな。
dialogues.en: "Oh...... you mean Captain Hiroshi Kawaguchi?"
dialogues.text: "Oh...... you mean Captain Hiroshi Kawaguchi?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「だから、じっくり話せるぞ。お題はもちろん、
　あの人についてだ！」
dialogues.en: "Who the hell is he?"
dialogues.text: "Who the hell is he?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.en:
"You don't know him? There's an expedition team called
Kawaguchi, and they find a mud lake that reflects the
sunshine and they..."
dialogues.text:
"You don't know him? There's an expedition team called
Kawaguchi, and they find a mud lake that reflects the
sunshine and they..."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「あー……、念のため聞いておくが、あの人っ
　て誰のことだ？」
dialogues.en: "Yoriko Sagisawa-san. You know, Sagie."
dialogues.text: "Yoriko Sagisawa-san. You know, Sagie."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「鷺澤頼子さん。サギーだ」
かったるい。
dialogues.en: What a pain.
dialogues.text: What a pain.

dialogues.jp:
「別に、話すような事なんてないっての。だい
　たいお前は、どういうのを期待してるんだ？」
dialogues.en:
"I have nothing to say about her. I mean, what are you
expecting to know?"
dialogues.text:
"I have nothing to say about her. I mean, what are you
expecting to know?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「そりゃ、彼女の生態というか生活だ。例えば
　だな、夜な夜な起きだしてあんどんの油を舐
　めるとか……」
dialogues.en:
"I want to know who she really is and all that. For example,
does she lick up melted candle wax at night?"
dialogues.text:
"I want to know who she really is and all that. For example,
does she lick up melted candle wax at night?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「妖怪じゃあるまいし」
dialogues.en: "What do you think she is, a monster?"
dialogues.text: "What do you think she is, a monster?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「だが、同じようなもんだろう？」
dialogues.en: "She's something like that, don't you think?"
dialogues.text: "She's something like that, don't you think?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「何にしろ、まだ会ったばっかりだ。そんなの
　分かるか」
dialogues.en:
"Anyway, I just met her yesterday. I don't know anything
about her."
dialogues.text:
"Anyway, I just met her yesterday. I don't know anything
about her."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「ふむ、それもそうか？」
dialogues.en: "Hmm, you're right."
dialogues.text: "Hmm, you're right."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「また、お前の事だから、舐めるように観察で
　もしているかと思ったが……」
dialogues.en: "I thought you might have been watching her every step."
dialogues.text: "I thought you might have been watching her every step."

dialogues.jp:
もはや反論するのも馬鹿らしく、黙って窓の外
に目を向ける。
dialogues.en:
It's too stupid to argue with him, so I look at the window
in silence.
dialogues.text:
It's too stupid to argue with him, so I look at the window
in silence.

dialogues.jp: （春だなあ……）
dialogues.en: (It's such a beautiful spring.)
dialogues.text: (It's such a beautiful spring.)

dialogues.jp: 窓枠の中の空は、しみ一つない青空だ。
dialogues.en:
The sky within the frame of the window is all blue, without
a cloud.
dialogues.text:
The sky within the frame of the window is all blue, without
a cloud.

dialogues.jp:
外はぽかぽかと気持ちよさそうで、窓を開けた
いところだが、あいにく春風は強い。
dialogues.en:
It looks like the weather outside is so calm and warm. It
makes me want to open the window, but actually the wind in
spring is really strong.
dialogues.text:
It looks like the weather outside is so calm and warm. It
makes me want to open the window, but actually the wind in
spring is really strong.

dialogues.jp:
プリントや教科書のページばかりでなく、杉並
まで吹っ飛ばしてくれるなら、喜んで全開にす
るのだが……。
dialogues.en:
If it were to blow away not only the study papers and some
pages from text books, but also Suginami, I'd open all the
windows with pleasure.
dialogues.text:
If it were to blow away not only the study papers and some
pages from text books, but also Suginami, I'd open all the
windows with pleasure.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「しかし朝倉」
dialogues.en: "But Asakura..."
dialogues.text: "But Asakura..."

dialogues.jp:
目の前で手をひらひらされ、仕方なくそっちに
目を向ける。
dialogues.en:
He waves his hand in front of my eyes, and I reluctantly
look at him.
dialogues.text:
He waves his hand in front of my eyes, and I reluctantly
look at him.

dialogues.jp: 「あんだ？」
dialogues.en: "What?"
dialogues.text: "What?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「お前、何で１時間も遅刻したんだ？　またぞ
　ろ、寝坊か？」
dialogues.en:
"Why were you late for the first class this morning? Did you
oversleep again?"
dialogues.text:
"Why were you late for the first class this morning? Did you
oversleep again?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「ああ、違う違う。洗濯機の使い方を説明して
　たんだよ」
dialogues.en: "No, no. I was teaching her how to use the washing machine."
dialogues.text: "No, no. I was teaching her how to use the washing machine."

dialogues.jp:
俺は今朝の出来事を説明した。まあ、勉強をす
るよりはマシな時間ではある。
dialogues.en:
I explain to him what happened this morning. I have to admit
talking with him is better than studying.
dialogues.text:
I explain to him what happened this morning. I have to admit
talking with him is better than studying.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「ほう、そいつは興味深いな。彼女には、一部
　の常識が欠けているのか」
dialogues.en: "Wow, that's interesting. So she has no common sense, huh?"
dialogues.text: "Wow, that's interesting. So she has no common sense, huh?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「まあ、少なくとも洗濯はした事なかったんだ
　ろうなあ……」
dialogues.en: "I guess she's never used a washing machine."
dialogues.text: "I guess she's never used a washing machine."

dialogues.jp: 再び窓の外に目を向けながら、もそもそと呟く。
dialogues.en: I answer quietly, looking out of the window again.
dialogues.text: I answer quietly, looking out of the window again.

dialogues.jp:
そうしながら俺は今朝のことを思い出していた。
頼子さんに仕事のリストを渡した時の事を。
dialogues.en: Then I remember the list of jobs I gave her this morning.
dialogues.text: Then I remember the list of jobs I gave her this morning.

dialogues.jp:
リストの中には、“買い物”という項目も含ま
れていた。
dialogues.en: In that list, there's an item saying 'Grocery shopping'.
dialogues.text: In that list, there's an item saying 'Grocery shopping'.

dialogues.jp:
頼子さんは、買い物だけはやりたくないと、そ
う言ったのだ。例の、不安げな表情で。
dialogues.en:
Yoriko told me she doesn't want to do grocery shopping. And
she had a desperate look on her face.
dialogues.text:
Yoriko told me she doesn't want to do grocery shopping. And
she had a desperate look on her face.

dialogues.jp: 「なあ、杉並……」
dialogues.en: "Hey, Suginami......"
dialogues.text: "Hey, Suginami......"

dialogues.jp: 顔をそむけたまま呟く。
dialogues.en: I say, looking out of the window.
dialogues.text: I say, looking out of the window.

dialogues.jp:
「泣きそうな顔で、外に出たくないと手を合わ
　せる人が居たとして……それは、どうしてだ
　ろうな？」
dialogues.en:
"If a person pleads with a crying face and says that she
doesn't want to go outside...... why do you think she says
that?"
dialogues.text:
"If a person pleads with a crying face and says that she
doesn't want to go outside...... why do you think she says
that?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「決まってる。その人は、外が嫌いなんだ」
dialogues.en: "It's easy. She doesn't like it outside."
dialogues.text: "It's easy. She doesn't like it outside."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「そうか……そうだよなあ……」
dialogues.en: "Yeah...... That's what I thought......"
dialogues.text: "Yeah...... That's what I thought......"

dialogues.jp:
この世の全てがいきいきと息づいている、そん
な春をガラスの向こうに｛かいま／垣間｝見ながら、俺は頷
いた。
dialogues.en:
I'm still looking out of the window at a beautiful spring
sight full of vital energy.
dialogues.text:
I'm still looking out of the window at a beautiful spring
sight full of vital energy.

dialogues.jp:
やはり、ガキに石を投げつけられたりした経験
が影響しているのだろうか？　それとも──？
dialogues.en:
Is she traumatized by the experience of kids throwing stones
at her? Or...?
dialogues.text:
Is she traumatized by the experience of kids throwing stones
at her? Or...?

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「どうしたんだ、お前？　ふにゃけたツラして」
dialogues.en:
"What's the matter with you? You look half-dead. Be careful,
dude. Spring can damage your mentality."
dialogues.text:
"What's the matter with you? You look half-dead. Be careful,
dude. Spring can damage your mentality."

dialogues.jp:
横顔にピシピシと、杉並の無礼な言葉が、ぶつ
かってくる。
dialogues.en: His rude words hit my face.
dialogues.text: His rude words hit my face.

dialogues.jp:
というか、俺の思案顔は、そんなにふにゃけた
ツラに見えるのだろうか……？
dialogues.en: Do I really look half-dead when I'm thinking......?
dialogues.text: Do I really look half-dead when I'm thinking......?

dialogues.jp: ◆外には出たくない◆
dialogues.en: ◆Suginami◆
dialogues.text: ◆Suginami◆

dialogues.jp:
次の時間が自習なのをいいことに、俺の前の席
に陣取った杉並は、あれやこれやと頼子さんの
事を尋ねてきた。

仕方なく俺は、朝の出来事を話し、あることを
思い出した。
dialogues.en: I seriously wonder, where does he always come from?
dialogues.text: I seriously wonder, where does he always come from?

dialogues.jp:
彼女の為に、仕事のリストを作ったのだが、何
故か彼女、外に出る事だけは嫌がったのだ。
dialogues.en: "Oh, I remember now. You're my classmate."
dialogues.text: "Oh, I remember now. You're my classmate."

dialogues.jp: 一体なんでなんだろう……。
dialogues.en:
"......Are you okay? I was also your classmate yesterday,
and we were breathing the same air in the same classroom,
you know."
dialogues.text:
"......Are you okay? I was also your classmate yesterday,
and we were breathing the same air in the same classroom,
you know."
